about: What a town's shrine holds about a deep site's seal, and the ways a company may argue it out, each tried once (src/world/deep/deep-argument.ts binds it into each deep site that has a seal and a town with a priest). In what is said, {priest} is the priest, said by their name; {name} is the deep site's name; {noun} is what the seal is asked about (the walled stair), {opened} what it opens, {cut} what is cut on it, {carry} what the shrine would have the company take below. In a move, needs is what it asks besides the priest's having spoken, check the roll it is (a skill and how hard), won whether it wins the priest over, learn a fact it teaches ({grief}: the priest's grief), caught whether a failed try shuts the shrine to the company, always whether even a won try does; {bane} is the fact of the keeper's bane.
grief: {priest}'s brother went down into {name} and did not come back up. What {priest} says of {opened} is grief as much as doctrine.
stand: 'The makers shut {opened} themselves,' says {priest}, 'and they knew what they were doing. What they shut in, they shut in for all of us. Open it, and I will not pray for you, nor heal you, nor sit up with your dead.'
carry: 'And take {carry} with you, if you find it.'
told: Then {priest} tells you what the shrine has always kept of it: {bane_said}

moves.label: Tell {priest} what {cut} say
moves.yes: {priest} hears the words out, and is quiet for a while. 'If the makers wrote that, they meant it to be read,' {priest} says at last. 'And meant someone to go down with the light.'
moves.no: {priest} hears the words out, and is not moved. 'Words cut in stone,' says {priest}. 'Anyone can cut words.'

moves.label: Argue with {priest} that what is below should be met, not walled in
moves.yes: {priest} argues it with you point by point, and gives way on the last one. 'Then go,' says {priest}, 'but go as if it mattered.'
moves.no: {priest} argues it with you point by point, and gives way on none of them.

moves.label: Watch {priest} for what goes unsaid
moves.yes: It is in how {priest} says 'down there': not as doctrine, but as a place someone went.
moves.no: Whatever goes unsaid, you do not see it.

moves.label: Speak to {priest} of the brother who went down
moves.yes: {priest} looks at you a long time. 'He went down into {name} and no one went after him,' says {priest}. 'If you are going, go after him too.'
moves.no: {priest} turns away. 'You know nothing about it,' says {priest}, and that is the end of it.

moves.label: Tell {priest} the keepers of names sent you to see to {opened}
moves.yes: {priest} looks at you for a long moment, and nods. 'Then see to it,' says {priest}.
moves.no: {priest} looks at you for a long moment. 'The keepers send their own,' says {priest}. 'Get out of my shrine.'

moves.label: Tell {priest} {opened} will be opened whatever is said
moves.yes: {priest} goes white, and tells you what you came to hear, to be rid of you. There will be nothing more for you from this shrine.
moves.no: {priest} is not afraid of you. 'Then open it without me,' says {priest}, 'and bury your own dead.'

promise.label: Promise {priest} to shut {opened} again when you come back up
promise.yes: {priest} takes your hand in both hands. 'Then I will hold you to it,' says {priest}. {told}

broken: {priest} looks past you at the door. 'You promised to shut it again,' says {priest}, and nothing more to you, then or after.
shut: {priest} will not look at you. The shrine is shut to whoever opened {opened} against its word.
